title: Wavelength calculation
description: Essential: The student must correctly compute the wavelength using λ = v/f, yielding λ = 2 m.

title: Constructive interference condition
description: Important: The student must state the condition for constructive interference as a path difference Δx = kλ, where k is an integer.

title: Path difference range
description: Important: The student must correctly identify that the maximum possible path difference on the S1S2 line is the source separation of 4 m.

title: Integer k determination
description: Important: The student must solve the inequality -4 m < kλ < 4 m (or equivalent) for integer k, finding k = -1, 0, 1.

title: Final count of points
description: Essential: The student must conclude there are 3 points of constructive interference on the line connecting S1 and S2.

title: Midpoint identification
description: Optional: The student may note that point B (the midpoint) corresponds to k=0 and is a point of constructive interference.

title: Sign or absolute value error
description: Pitfall: The student incorrectly uses the condition |Δx| = kλ without considering negative k, or misapplies the absolute value in the inequality.

title: Unit inconsistency
description: Pitfall: The student fails to use consistent units in the wavelength calculation or path difference inequality, leading to an incorrect count.
